name: quran-api
description: A free and open-source multilingual Qur'an REST API providing surahs, ayahs, audio, and support for custom reciters. Easy to integrate into your frontend or any project that needs reliable Qur'an data.

paragraphs: Static Quran RESTful API is a fast and multilingual Node.js project (built with JavaScript/TypeScript and Express) that provides complete Quran data in JSON format — including surahs, ayahs, and translations (currently in English and Indonesian). It also supports murottal audio from up to 30 reciters, with per-ayah playback fetched from third-party sources. Designed for speed and flexibility, this API helps developers easily integrate Quran data and audio into their applications.
